vehicles.name: Tradie Ute
vehicles.summary: The owner's dual-cab Mitsubishi Triton (MQ) as a roster car (R123), rebuilt against the owner's photos after the 2026-10-11 review (br-bwju.8): the black flat-top canopy on a flat tray with checker-plate under-tray boxes, the platform roof rack with a wind deflector and a rolled awning on the left, the chrome "dynamic shield" grille with swept headlights on a tall blunt nose, a solid black bull bar (light bar, fog lamps, winch hook), the snorkel on the driver's A-pillar, a small lift, black wheels with a silver lip, plain paint. Rear drive, 1900 kg: heavier and torquier than the Cruz, lower top speed. Detail pass (2026-10-17): the canopy's real hardware (the upper doors' T-handles and gas struts, a louvred vent, the drip rail, chrome corner protectors, amber and red reflectors), its rear door with a tinted window, T-handle and third brake light, a seat-coloured lid with tie-down rails, door handles, the chrome shoulder line and the J-line where the cab meets the tray, the black rocker, and taller tray lamps; the paint stays plain, as on the owner's car. Before and after: docs/evidence/br-bwju.8/ute-before-after-views.png.

vehicles.name: Hawk Dash
vehicles.summary: R123's Hawk Dash: a bubbly Aussie V8 sedan in the spirit of the Falcon XR8 Sprint. Long bonnet with a power bulge and two vents, a gaping hexagonal grille under swept narrow lamps, vertical lamp slots in the bumper corners, wide wrap-around tail lamps, quad exhausts, a ducktail lip, twin stripes nose to tail and a side 'C' stripe. Code-built from a generated reference sheet (R81). Rear drive, 1700 kg: the Lion President's spec twin.

specTwin.sharedSpec: One spec, two bodies (R123): the Hawk Dash and the Lion President name spec 'aussie-v8' in web/shared/src/roster.json, and their profiles' handling (tuning) is identical, held by tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs. Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

vehicles.name: Lion President
vehicles.summary: R123's Lion President: a bubbly Aussie V8 sedan in the spirit of the last V8 Commodore, the SS-V Redline. Gloss-black roof, two big forward-facing bonnet nostrils, angular lamps with LED fangs, a wide lower grille split by one thick bar, slatted air curtains, side skirts, a tall wing on posts, a full-width tail lamp on a black band, a black diffuser with quad exhausts, red calipers and a black-and-gold shoulder pinstripe. Code-built from a generated reference sheet (R81). Rear drive, 1700 kg: the Hawk Dash's spec twin.

vehicles.name: Pig Catcher
vehicles.summary: R123's Pig Catcher: a bubbly outback trail bike in the spirit of the DR-Z400E (no Suzuki branding): tall long-travel forks, a beaked front mudguard, wide plastics, a light bar with two spotlights, and a rear rack carrying a coiled rope and a hessian sack. The rider is part of the model, standing on the pegs in a green MX helmet, khaki shirt and jeans. Code-built from a generated reference sheet (R81), on the bike part set (core, front, back, rider, wheel_F, wheel_R).

vehicles.name: Postie Bike
vehicles.summary: R123's Postie Bike: a bubbly Australian step-through delivery motorbike in the spirit of the 110 cc postie (generic: no Australia Post branding). A big raked leg shield, a front carrier with a mail tub, two postal-red panniers stacked with parcels, round mirrors and chunky little knobblies. The rider is part of the model: open-face white helmet, hi-vis vest over a blue work shirt. Code-built from a generated reference sheet (R81), on the bike part set (core, front, back, rider, wheel_F, wheel_R).
